notes.zh-CN: 输入框项目芯片新增“切换项目”列表，可直接进入其他项目的新会话页；优化 Claude 用量展示，将词元统计与套餐额度整合至输入框用量胶囊；设置面板精简与稳定性优化。macOS 为 universal 开发签名、未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；Android APK 为调试签名；iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Adds a Switch project list to the composer project chip for opening new sessions in other projects; integrates Claude token usage and plan limits into the composer usage pill; simplifies the settings panel and improves overall stability. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
